tasks.gr9-oral-literature-narrative-t3: Topic: Oral literature and narrative traditions. Cover folktales, myths, oral presentation, interview techniques, and instruction. Ask Grade 9 learners to explain features of oral traditions, present information clearly to listeners, demonstrate appropriate pace and tone in oral delivery, conduct interviews with focused questioning, and use gesture and expression to enhance meaning.
tasks.gr9-reports-instructional-texts-t3: Topic: Reports and instructional texts. Cover report writing, narrative control, instructional writing with clear sequencing, audience awareness, and information organization. Ask Grade 9 learners to write reports that organise information clearly and accurately, create instructional texts with numbered steps and imperative verbs, match detail and vocabulary to audience, and demonstrate text-type feature mastery.
tasks.gr9-advanced-language-context-t3: Topic: Advanced language in context. Cover active and passive voice, reported speech transformations, figurative language (metaphor, simile, personification, hyperbole), and complex sentence patterns with cause-effect relationships. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify and transform voice, convert direct to reported speech, recognise figurative language and explain effects, and analyse complex sentence structures in context.
